entities.summary: Anton Olegovich Yelizarov , also known by his nom de guerre "Lotos", is a Russian mercenary leader and military officer, one of the commanders of PMC Wagner Group. He has medals of the Hero of Russia, Donetsk People's Republic and Luhansk People's Republic.
